title: Book of Abominations
short_description: A cosy Lovecraftian monster tamer that combines the cute with the grotesque — capture Eldritch horrors in snappy turn-based combat and unravel the secrets within the book.
description: Book of Abominations is a cosy Lovecraftian monster tamer that combines the cute with the grotesque. Capture and battle Eldritch horrors in snappy turn based combat, explore a mysterious, moody yet vibrant world, and unravel the secrets within the book!
